question: Should OpenClaw accept `currentTokenCount` plus these SDK token-budget helpers as a stable public ContextEngine/plugin SDK contract now, or fold the token-budget signal into the broader assemble metadata work in #82137?
rationale: The PR changes public plugin API surface that third-party context engines can compile against, while a broader related assemble metadata RFC is still open.

options.title: Accept Narrow Contract After Proof
options.body: Approve the focused `currentTokenCount` API now, then require real behavior proof plus refreshed SDK/docs generated artifacts before merge.

options.title: Fold Into RFC #82137
options.body: Pause or close this branch and handle token counts together with the broader provenance/internal-event assemble metadata design.

options.title: Keep Helpers Private For Now
options.body: Avoid SDK helper exports until maintainers settle the long-term plugin API and compatibility plan.

recommendation.title: Accept Narrow Contract After Proof
recommendation.body: Approve the focused `currentTokenCount` API now, then require real behavior proof plus refreshed SDK/docs generated artifacts before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: They are assigned to the PR and have the strongest recent history on the context-engine assemble budgeting path.
